svg.title: Observed On-Call Watch failure modes
svg.desc: Three observed, reproducible failure modes from committed evaluation runs.
svg.text: OBSERVED IN THE LAB · NOT HYPOTHETICAL

text.tspan: A restraint metric can be passed by not looking
the tick counter explains it. gpt-oss watched an average of 3.6 ticks and Qwen 5.8, on every archetype, when the evidence
needs 8 to 19 ticks depending on the scenario. They did not exercise restraint; they stopped watching before anything had…
The slow burn is invisible to an impatient watcher
latency and error rate drift steadily past the SLO across twenty minutes without any single alarming sample. An agent that
stops at tick 4 sees a perfectly healthy service, because at tick 4 the service is healthy. The incident is in the trend,…
Watching everything is not judgement either
Mistral is the patient model (patience_ok 0.978, mean 19.2 of 20 ticks) and it catches every genuine incident
(caught_incident 1.000). But it watched 19.1 ticks on maintenance windows too, where the service context settles the…

svg.text: Open FAILURE_MODES.md for scenario IDs, evidence, impact, and reproduction commands.
